title: A Probe Survived 127 Minutes on Venus at 457 Degrees

scenes.text: A spacecraft survived 127 minutes on the surface of Venus.
The ground there is 457 degrees Celsius, hot enough to melt lead.
The air pressure is 89 times Earth's, like being almost a mile deep in the ocean.
Venera 13 landed in 1982 and was built to last only 32 minutes.
It sent back the first colour pictures from the surface of Venus.
Then it was cooked and crushed into silence.
Nothing has lasted longer on Venus since.

description:
In 1982, the Venera 13 probe survived 127 minutes on Venus at 457 degrees Celsius and 89 times Earth's air pressure.
It was built for only 32 minutes.
Would you ever visit Venus?
first_comment: Why do you think nobody has landed on Venus since?
